mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without any threshold condition.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show no positive correlation with FEDFUNDS trend (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in private employment signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through improved corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint movement of UNRATE and PAYEMS fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In early-cycle expansion regimes characterized by rising housing starts, the S&P 500 exhibits positive forward returns as consumer confidence and spending increase, driven by HOUST growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative when HOUST > 1250.0 in more than 40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production over the past 3 months indicates robust supply chain conditions that support corporate profitability, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO trend shows no positive correlation with SPX 60-day returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 3.5% for two consecutive months, it signals a tight labor market that increases wage pressures and corporate costs, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% for 2 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production and rise in the federal funds rate signals a supply shock coupled with monetary tightening, reducing corporate margins and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint movement of INDPRO and FEDFUNDS fails to predict SPX returns (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-inflation peak regimes, a decline in industrial production signals weakening economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances during the post-inflation peak regime.
